blocks.orig: Located in beautiful Moshi, you find warm African hospitality along with simple comforts at the Karanga River Lodge. At just 20 kilometres from Mount Kilimanjaro, you can count on superior views of this iconic mountain every day! The lodge offers 10 single or double rooms, all ensuite with a bathroom matching European standards, and decorated with a personal, homely touch. Once you have settled into your room, you can take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool and then recline on the lounge chairs with a freshly squeezed juice or fruit platter. You’re in for some culinary delights too, as the chef prepares local dishes with a creative touch, lots of love, and fresh ingredients.
